items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: The personnel on these recordings were Mr. Blakeney, trumpet; ... Jake Porter, trumpet

ctx.x: I think he had a company about that time. Anyway, I made about three sides with C.L. .... a big band, three trumpets, four saxes and Jake Porter was on one of these records.
Do you remember the names of any of the songs that you did?
